name: agentic-github-flow-web-deploy
description: Pre-deploy hardening check for a website on Vercel with Supabase (optional Google sign-in) or on Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, IAP, Secret Manager), including its mail domain and EU privacy.

interface.shortDescription: Pre-deploy hardening check for a website on Vercel with Supabase (optional Google sign-in) or on Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, IAP, Secret Manager), including its mail domain and EU privacy.
interface.longDescription: Reads the repository (migrations, configuration, the deploy code, headers, auth flow, mail, privacy, dependencies) and gives the user a dashboard checklist and a ready or not-ready verdict. Deploys nothing and touches no live project.
